description:
## [1.0.2-dev.1](https://github.com/Just-a0user/what-it-should-be/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2-dev.1) (2026-11-18)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* add name-filter to anti-revoke queue-drain and status-revoke blocks ([afc09f7](https://github.com/Just-a0user/what-it-should-be/commit/afc09f715f379845d99834fce82dac58c1c9304d))
* Disable Remove Meta AI and Keep deleted messages by default ([211b7e9](https://github.com/Just-a0user/what-it-should-be/commit/211b7e98286d6bfd8409b0e5a08b4b1868275b5c))
* Publish first WhatsApp patches bundle for 2.26.44.90 ([f1cbe96](https://github.com/Just-a0user/what-it-should-be/commit/f1cbe9626249a1c202ac4338b617369cc4cdf13f))

patches.name: Anti Detector
patches.description: Spoof APK-integrity, root, Xposed, and Play Integrity checks so WhatsApp reports a clean, unmodified install to its own telemetry and to its server.

options.description: Make the app believe the device is not rooted.
Make the app believe no hook framework is active.
No-op Play Integrity / SafetyNet API calls and force pass result.

patches.name: Anti Revoke Expertenmodus
patches.description: Prevent others from deleting their messages or statuses. Companion to Keep Deleted Messages — that patch keeps text visible locally; this one stops the revoke ACK so the server cannot confirm delivery of the deletion.

options.description: Also prevent others from deleting their status/story updates.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Show messages that were deleted for everyone. Client-side only; already-wiped history cannot be restored.

options.description: Reserved for future UI tinting of kept-deleted rows.

patches.name: Login Fix Expertenmodus
patches.description: Experimental login compatibility patch for a re-signed APK. Requires compatible microG-RE components. Enable only if registration/login fails.

patches.name: Remove Meta AI
patches.description: Hides Meta AI on the chats home screen (FAB / pill), related hub entry points, and common feature gates. Does not delete existing Meta AI chats.

options.description: Also force extra ()Z methods in Meta-AI-anchored classes. May hide unrelated AI experiments; leave off unless the FAB still shows.

patches.name: Usage data
patches.description: Limit diagnostic and analytics data WhatsApp sends.

patches.name: View once media
patches.description: Allow reopening and saving view once photos and videos.

patches.name: WhatsApp Morphe
patches.description: All-in-one patch: login fix, keep deleted messages, view-once unlock, anti-detection, anti-revoke, remove Meta AI, limit telemetry.

options.description: Bypass APK signature / cert checks that block SMS verification on re-signed APKs. Requires microG-RE. Enable if registration / login fails.
Show messages that were deleted for everyone. Client-side only.
Allow reopening and saving view-once photos and videos.
Spoof APK-integrity, root, Xposed and Play Integrity checks.
Make the app believe the device is not rooted.
Make the app believe no hook framework is active.
No-op Play Integrity / SafetyNet API calls and force pass result.
Prevent others from deleting their messages or statuses on your client.
Also prevent others from deleting their status/story updates.
Hide the Meta AI FAB/pill on the home screen and hub entry points.
Force extra boolean gates in Meta-AI classes. Leave off unless FAB still shows.
Limit diagnostic and analytics data WhatsApp sends.
